## Activity

During April 2022, River Outreach recorded 38 captures. This activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The figures describe the volume processed during the month and the outcomes associated with those captures.

## Image quality

Of the 38 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.9 per cent. These results identify the captures for which image quality was insufficient for grading. The rate is reported alongside the count to support monitoring of image quality at River Outreach.

No new equipment faults were raised by staff during the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 0. This indicates that the midpoint of the recorded grading intervals was 0 for the reporting period. The referable count should be considered together with the image-quality results, including the 3 ungradable captures, when reviewing the month’s activity.

Overall, the report records 38 captures, an ungradable rate of 7.9 per cent, and 4 referable results for River Outreach in April 2022.
